summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K reporting the cancellation of 6,918,800 ordinary shares of US$0.50 each on 6 October 2026, previously repurchased on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange under the buy-back announced 5 August 2026. Post-cancellation, 17,135,023,491 ordinary shares remain in issue with none held in treasury, leaving total voting rights at that figure. No price, stake, advisor, or board recommendation is stated. The notice is a routine UK-style transparency update; watch for further cancellations under the buy-back and any update to the repurchase programme's remaining authorization.
